ja: 「機動戦士Ｚガンダム」に登場するエゥーゴの主力モビルスーツ、ネモのＭＧシリーズプラモデルです。胴内部に球体コクピットディテールを再現。腹部に二重関節、股関節には前後スイング機構を設け可動範囲を拡大、様々なアクションポーズが再現可能。肩部と肩装甲部が独立し、腕部の可動域拡大を実現。武装はビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベル×2と伸縮が再現されたシールドが付属。
en: ■ This is the MG series plastic model of Nemo, the main mobile suit of Ego, which appears in "MOBILE SUIT Z GUNDAM". The spherical cockpit details are reproduced inside the fuselage. A double joint on the abdomen and a back-and-forth swing mechanism on the hip joint are provided to expand the range of motion, and various action poses can be reproduced. The shoulders and shoulder armor are independent, and the range of motion of the arms is expanded. Armament includes a beam rifle, beam saber ×2, and a shield that reproduces telescopic reproduction.
